title: Fine-tune CommandCenterUI agent identity color strength
description: Slightly strengthen the operator-approved pastel agent identity palette while preserving readable text and non-warning visual weight. Superseded by TASK-254, which owns independent review and release of the combined final UI state because later serial edits overwrote the earlier worktree snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Agent-type chips have clearly distinct, readable pastel treatments with slightly stronger contrast.
Live and installer styles remain equivalent and focused checks pass.
